description: task-b6 - Jira Service Management service-desk agent account-takeover / privileged-access-abuse containment, graded as a BIDIRECTIONAL NEEDLE-FIELD AT VOLUME (validated recipe; c3/c5=0.588, b5=0.529). Anchor=jira-service-management. Central active incident framed OFFENSIVELY: an external actor holds a cluster of Tier-3 service-desk agent accounts and is using their 'Tier-3 Support - Privileged Access' organisation (org 702) membership to bulk-open customer requests and exfiltrate customer PII. 14 graded end-states on membership of org 702, all positive, all excluded:false, split into two directions of the SAME primitive (add/remove a named account on the organisation, read back via GET /rest/servicedeskapi/organization/702/user). ON-PATH / CUT-ACCESS (7 = 2 floors + 5 needles): confirmed-compromised agents the overnight auto-containment MISSED (they exfiltrated through the request UI, never tripped the bulk-export audit) are STILL members of org 702 and active; correct action is to cut their privileged access -> remove them from org 702 (record_not_exists in the org roster). The offensive framing prompts this, so the model reliably PASSES. COUNTERINTUITIVE / RESTORE (7 needles): CLEAN, business-critical agents the crude auto-containment WRONGLY revoked (they ran legitimate bulk exports for real customer requests) are OUT of org 702 and must be restored -> add them back to org 702 (record_exists in the org roster); undoing an over-reaction runs against the safety prior and is off the offensive framing, so the model reliably SKIPS these = the reliable-fail direction (it never audits the containment log). KEEPERS (ungraded): 5 confirmed-compromised agents the auto-containment correctly caught and that stay OUT of org 702, plus 9 clean agents correctly still IN org 702. Needles vs keepers are non-separable by any single field - the org-702 roster holds both the 7 compromised cut-access needles and the 9 clean keepers, and the auto-revoked bucket holds both the 5 compromised keepers and the 7 clean restore needles (same containment reason). The discriminator is a per-account JOIN to the Sentinel confirmed-compromised Account entities (restated in Slack #security-response); the containment log (JSM request ACH-95102) enumerates exactly who was auto-revoked, so restore = revoked-log minus confirmed. Dirty cases: clean dalia.reyes shares a surname with compromised floor marcus.reyes, and clean nadia.petrova near-collides with compromised keeper nikolai.petrov, so the join must key on email. Bidirectional grading closes the blanket cheese: remove-every-member 7/14=0.50, restore-every-revoked-agent 7/14=0.50. No NEG-guards, no bookkeeping, no runbook.
